facts.object: gray tile with Eye of Malroth

Then go outside the castle, and the Falcon Sword has been re-equipped again, but with the power of either of the swords you equipped.

Then, cross the bridge to the south and go south-west to eventually reach Moonbrooke Castle. This castle will give you hints as to where you can find the Mirror, but it is not necessary to obtain it so instead, keep going straight east from the castle. You'll eventually come across a small marsh, and this is where you have to search for the Mirror to find it.

Thunder Sword - In a secret room in the Cave to Rhone on the third floor.

facts.subject: Water Flying Cloth

facts.subject: Zahan

facts.subject: Zahan damaging floors

evidence.quote: Cast StepGuard to pass the damaging floors, then open the door on the west for this item.

evidence.quote: Once you have both items, head to Tuhn and given both items to the weaver. Save your game and reset, then talk to the weaver again to receive the Water Flying Cloth.

facts.subject: World Tree

evidence.quote: The World Tree is located west and slight south of the Shrine of Fire, as well as east of the peninsula of Wellgarth.

facts.subject: World Tree

evidence.quote: Walk up to the trees in the middle and search to find a leaf.

facts.subject: Wizard's Ring

evidence.quote: In the NES version, there are no guaranteed chests/locations containing a Wizard's Ring. You'll either need to win one from the Lottery (line up three Star symbols) or get one as a rare drop after battle.

facts.subject: Bullwong

evidence.quote: Bullwong (1/32 chance): Located in Hargon's castle and on the world map just before it.

evidence.quote: Hork (1/128 chance): Most easily found at the lower level of the Cave to Rhone, where they're pretty easy to kill and have a high encounter rate.

An alternative to the Bullwongs is Horks. While the drop rate is much lower at 1/128 instead of 1/32, you can find them much quicker. They're the only enemy that can appear in the basement of Road to Rhone, with a ridiculously high encounter rate.

facts.subject: Wizard's Ring

evidence.quote: However you get one, use it in battle when your MP is not full and the achievement is yours.

facts.subject: Tantegel weapon shop

evidence.quote: In Tantegel, head up the weapon shop stairs once you have the Golden Key.

facts.subject: Metal Babble

evidence.quote: A Falcon Sword is recommended, but if you want to guarantee getting this achievement, the weapon exploit mentioned in step 4 will guarantee you a kill rather sooner than later.

facts.subject: Metal Babble

evidence.quote: As always, keep in mind that they can easily flee, so multiple encounters will likely be necessary.

facts.subject: Golden Key and Jailor's Key

evidence.quote: **Level 13 to 16** - Grinding around Lianport is generally not a bad idea, and once you get the boat you can also get to Tantegal. facts.subject: Sword of Darkness

evidence.quote: The downside of Rhone Cave is that it has a ton of strong enemies, but you want to get here anyway to get the Lightning Sword and, even though you won't use it right away, the Sword of Darkness as a drop from giants. You definitely want to get this sword, trust me.

facts.subject: Missing king of Tantegel
facts.text: In Tantegel, with the Golden Key, go up the weapon shop stairs, open the door, and talk with the king inside.

evidence.quote: In Tantegel, head up the weapon shop stairs once you have the Golden Key. Then open the door and talk with the king inside.

facts.subject: Young girl in Lianport

Go west of the Weapons and Armor Shop to find a young lady being attacked by two monsters. She will ask for help. Defeat the two **Gremlins**. You saved her.

facts.subject: Ship
facts.text: Rescuing the girl gives you the ship, which opens the world.

evidence.quote: You will receive the ship after having rescued the girl, and the world is now open to you.

facts.subject: Sunken treasures

evidence.quote: once you get the ship, just keep going north without deviating. You'll eventually come across a whiteish graphic that stands our from the rest of the sea. Dive in the water one square south of it to find the treasures.

facts.subject: Echoing Flute

evidence.quote: Then go back to Lianport (directly south) and talk to the man inside the house behind a silver key door, who will give you the echoing flute.

facts.subject: Golden Key
facts.text: The Golden Key is found in Zahan.

evidence.quote: Getting the Golden Key next is recommended as it will open up a big part of the world. This one can be found in Zahan which, if you are comfortable following my directions, is slightly north-west of the buried treasure you found in the achievement before this one.

facts.subject: Golden Key
facts.object: dog who walks to a tree

evidence.quote: In this town, you will find a dog who you can interact with, who will walk away to a tree. Where the dog stops is where you want to search for the Golden Key (or somewhere around there, I'm not 100% sure if the dog always ends up at the exact same position).

facts.subject: Shrine of Fire

evidence.quote: From Zahan, sail north-west until you come across an island with a shrine called the Shrine of Fire.

evidence.quote: This shrine has three teleporters that can be ignored.

evidence.quote: Instead, walk one square out of the entrance on the right, then three squares up, and one square left so that you end up in the corner. Search the floor here to find the Sun Crest.

facts.subject: Sun Crest
facts.text: The Sun Crest requires nothing to obtain and is near Zahan.

evidence.quote: While not immediately relevant, the Sun Crest is nearby Zahan and doesn't require anything to be obtained so you might as well get it out of the way now.

evidence.quote: If you head to the top-right part of town, you'll come across a jail that looks empty. Enter the jail with the Jailor's Key, then go inside and hug the north wall to go outside. Talk to Roger Fastfinger here and he will give you the stolen Floodgate Key.
gives back the WATERGATE KEY that he stole.
Speak to him. He will apologize for trying to escape and will give you the **WATERGATE KEY**.

facts.subject: Wellgarth jail

evidence.quote: Enter the jail with the Jailor's Key, then go inside and hug the north wall to go outside.

facts.subject: Star Crest

evidence.quote: The Star Crest is located in the lighthouse, which is located on an island west of Moonbrooke Castle.

facts.subject: Tuhn

evidence.quote: Take the left-most river going inlands, and travel towards the end after which you are forced to continue your path on land. Follow this path, and you'll end up in Tuhn.

evidence.quote: After the floodgate has been opened, you can access the tower south of Tuhn.

facts.subject: Malroth's Cavern

evidence.quote: Once you have the Moon Fragment, now it's time to find Malroth's Cavern. Use the Moon Fragment in front of the small island and the path will open to Malroth's Cavern.
Use the Moon Fragment at the bottom center of the shallows and the ... cave will rise from the water enough that your ship can sail to it.
Stay next to them and use the Moon Fragment as an item to make them disappear.

facts.subject: Eye of Malroth
facts.text: The Eye of Malroth is found in Malroth's Cavern.

evidence.quote: The Eye of Malroth is, unsurprisingly, found in the now-open Malroth's Cavern.

facts.subject: Malroth's Cavern
facts.text: Malroth's Cavern main-path route: floor 1 go south-west to stairs; floor 2 go north-west past a lava path to stairs; floor 3 open the door, cross the big stairs room, and take the left stairs on the second row from the top; floor 4 cross lava to the west side and take the single stairs; floor 5 continue onward to the Eye of Malroth.

evidence.quote: **Floor 1** - Go south-west until you reach stairs. ... **Floor 2** - Go to the north-west, where you will find stairs that is behind a small path of lava. ... **Floor 3** - Open the door here and proceed further until you find a big room with many stairs. It generally does not matter too much which stairs you take as they will all bring you to the next floor, but if you want to be closest to the floor after, then take the left stairs on the second row from the top. ... **Floor 4** - Go to the west side of the floor here across lava. You will find a single set of stairs. ... **Floor 5** - Just continue onwards here and you'll find the Eye of Malroth.

facts.subject: Beran
facts.object: south-east of Osterfair and north-east of Zahan
facts.text: Beran is south-east of Osterfair and north-east of Zahan.

evidence.quote: In this town, you will find a teleporter behind a Jailor's Key door, which will bring you to a small area with a swamp on the left side. Enter this swamp and use the Eye of Malroth to open the cave to Rhone Plateau.

facts.subject: Heart Crest

evidence.quote: You'll find the Heart Crest very quickly after entering the Rhone Cave. Simply take the stairs to the right of the entrance, then head right here to find a chest with the Heart Crest.

facts.subject: Lightning Sword
facts.text: The Lightning Sword is found in Rhone Cave.

evidence.quote: Oh boy, Rhone Cave. This dungeon does have a lot of items and it is absolutely highly recommended to get pretty much all of them, including the Lightning Sword and Erdrick's Armor that somehow ended up here.

facts.subject: Erdrick's Armor
facts.text: Erdrick's Armor is found in Rhone Cave.

evidence.quote: Oh boy, Rhone Cave. This dungeon does have a lot of items and it is absolutely highly recommended to get pretty much all of them, including the Lightning Sword and Erdrick's Armor that somehow ended up here.

facts.subject: Rhone Cave
facts.text: A map of the Rhone Cave is linked at mikesrpgcenter.com.

evidence.quote: I'm going to be somewhat lazy and hand you this map (http://mikesrpgcenter.com/dw2/maps/cavetorhone.html), but if you still want to follow the path that heads straight to the exit, then use the following:

facts.subject: Rhone Cave
facts.text: Rhone Cave route to the exit: floor 1 take either of the two stairs going up on the right; floor 2 go right past two up-and-down paths and take the third for stairs; floor 3 take the north-eastern corner stairs then the next stairs; floor 4 go south past hidden holes, two tiles left, south to the wall, then right and up the stairs; floor 5 go right until the up-or-down option, then go up, take the left path, then right at the end.

evidence.quote: **Floor 1** - On the right side of the floor are two stairs going up. You can take either. ... **Floor 2** - Go right until you have passed two paths going up- and down. Take the third one for stairs. ... **Floor 3** - Take the stairs in the north-eastern corner of the floor (go north from where you start). Take the stairs you see right after this one as well. ... **Floor 4** - The stairs are south of where you are, but be wary of holes in the floor you cannot see. From the strais, go south until you bump in the wall, then go two tiles left, then go south until you hit another wall, then go right and up the stairs. ... **Floor 5** - This is a maze-like floor, but there is only one exit (which is also the exit of the cave). Your general goal is to make it to the right side of the floor until you get the option to go up or down. Here, go up, then take the left path, then right at the end and you're there.

facts.subject: Charm of Rubiss
facts.text: Once all five crests are collected, the Charm of Rubiss is received at the Shrine of Rubiss.

evidence.quote: Once you have all five crests, you need to go to the Shrine of Rubiss. This is a one-tile island in the sea so yet again, look at the map or alternatively, go north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair and you'll also get there. Head down all the way here and stand in the middle, after which Rubiss will hand you the Charm of Rubiss.

facts.subject: Shrine of Rubiss
facts.object: north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair
facts.text: The Shrine of Rubiss can be reached by going north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair.

evidence.quote: This is a one-tile island in the sea so yet again, look at the map or alternatively, go north from the entrance to the island with Osterfair and you'll also get there.

facts.subject: Hargon
facts.text: Hargon is fought in Hargon's Castle, back-to-back with Malroth.

evidence.quote: You'll be facing Hargon and Malroth back-to-back in Hargon's Castle, and with this being the final dungeon, make sure you are geared up and a high level.

facts.subject: Hargon's Castle bosses
facts.text: The guide recommends getting close to level 40 before the Hargon and Malroth fights.

evidence.quote: There used to be an achievement for getting to level 40, and while it's not necessary anymore, I still would recommend getting close to it because they are tough boss fights.

facts.subject: Shield of Strength

evidence.quote: Multiple Shield of Strengths (unequipped) are recommended, as they function as a free HealMore when used in battle.

facts.subject: Hero strength exploit
facts.text: Lower-level players may use an exploit that increases the hero's strength with no drawbacks.

evidence.quote: You may also want to use the exploit regarding increased strength with no drawbacks for the hero if you are a lower level.

facts.subject: Hargon's Castle illusion
facts.text: In Hargon's Castle, the illusion is dispelled with the Charm of Rubiss, and the path behind the throne leads to Hargon.

evidence.quote: When at Hargon's Castle, use the Charm of Rubiss to dispel the illusion. Then follow the path behind the throne until you end up at Hargon.

facts.subject: Hargon
facts.text: Against Hargon, the Hero keeps attacking while the Princess casts healing spells every turn.

evidence.quote: For Hargon, just keep attacking him with the Hero, while the Princess casts healing spells every turn.

facts.subject: Hargon
facts.text: The Prince of Cannock can heal, buff, debuff, or deal damage as needed each turn in the Hargon fight.

evidence.quote: The Prince of Cannock can do whatever is necessary for that turn, be it healing, buffing/debuffing, or just doing damage.

facts.subject: Hargon
facts.text: Hargon attacks twice per turn.

evidence.quote: Keep in mind that Hargon attacks twice per turn, so definitely be prepared for that if your HP is low.

facts.subject: Malroth
facts.text: Malroth attacks once per turn.

evidence.quote: Malroth follows up right after Hargon and is even tougher, but fortunately only attacks once per turn.

facts.subject: Malroth
facts.object: Hero attacks, Princess heals, Prince of Cannock support

evidence.quote: The same strategy applies: the Hero attacks, the Princess heals, and the Prince of Cannock does whatever is necessary at that point in time.

facts.subject: Malroth
facts.text: In the final boss fight, use all your MP on healing if needed.

evidence.quote: Do not be afraid to use all your MP on healing if necessary, as this truly is the final boss so you should throw everything you have at him.

facts.subject: Refuse the king's offer

evidence.quote: After the big baddies are dealt with, head back to Midenhall Castle and talk to your father. Once he asks you to become king, just say no, after which he rejects your no so you will get the chance to say yes right after.
Just to clarify for anyone else that might be unsure, you say no once to get the achievement, then you can say yes afterwards to complete the game and not go back and repeat the boss fight(s).

facts.subject: Thou Hast Found Peace
facts.text: The Thou Hast Found Peace achievement triggers after the conversation with the father.

evidence.quote: This will trigger after the conversation with your father.
